docs.text: should i buy a wet suit to swim in lake michigan

contemplating so hard putting on a wetsuit on this 59 degree day and going in lake michigan. I really wanna but also I dunnooo. been stanting with my feet in the water for like an hour just wanting to hahahaha
for the one week a year you don't need a wetsuit to surf the Great Lakes

Remembered that I'm going to the Great Lakes in a few weeks, and realized I'm in dire need of a new swimsuit before then. I'm not used to having my midriff uncovered, but I do keep thinking about black bandini + boardshorts and a contrasting rashguard, as a look...

I went camping at McLain state park in Michigans UP and they had a wet suit warning posted. so I asked what is a wetsuit warning and I was told you have to wear one before going swimming in Lake Superior !🥶
That damn suit got a friend of mine hit by a boat in Lake Michigan, and she wouldn't sue.
I have in Lake Huron and while you don't need a wet suit or anything, it's definitely on the colder end of what's comfortable, even when it's hot out
I've used a 5/4 suit years ago for kitesurfing into late Nov on Lake Ontario and Georgian bay. Sadly that wetsuit is long long. I'm keen to try that again.

Owned an incredible Carhartt full body suit that kept me going through some truly terrible winters up along the coast of Lake Superior in Michigan's UP. Lasted almost two decades before the entire zipper section disintegrated
I want to swim in Lake Ontario in the winter, in a wet suit, or maybe a dry suit if is wimp out. Enjoy the water.

Did you ever swim a race in open water? Looking at a tri in September with a 73 est H2O temp, but if goes well, that’d lead into a half IM in Lake Michigan (65). Figure that one’ll need a wetsuit, but dunno if you go full, cap, etc…
I hope you have a good wetsuit if you’re swimming in Lake Michigan. 🥶

A word about wetsuits. I have a 3mm farmer john bottom and a 2mm top. That was good. I also had 1mm socks. 1mm won't cut it, my feet got cold. If I dumped I'm confident I would make it to shore. I'm less confident I'd be happy about it.

The proximate reason for me buying the wetsuit is adult beginner dinghy sailing lessons starting next weekend in Lake Ontario. I hope that this wetsuit is thick enough. Mostly I hope to not be in the lake too much, but ... it is still only May, so if/when I go in the water, it'll be cold.
